finalText:
**Big, but the risky parts are few.** 1,291 hits. 94 files. 5 services.

Three zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | Regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | Applied in prod. History |
| [openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) and [serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) WIRE values | 2 | Frozen public contract |

The DB column stays `account_id` too. So 275 SQL lines keep it. Only local names rename.

Next: I can list the 75 safe files.
